recentItems.title: Isaac Hayes - Walk On By (Official Visualizer) - from The Best of Isaac Hayes
recentItems.description:
Track taken from the compilation album The Best of Isaac Hayes (2025).

You can dig it!  Check out the entire visualizer playlist here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL79xK-VVZpsk5xcE-5DIdHXsSp6UBjExi

About the collection:
The Best Of Isaac Hayes brings together 10 soulful cuts from Stax Records’ incomparable creative force. As composer, producer, singer and multi-instrumentalist Isaac Hayes changed the face of music in the early 1970s and this collection is the perfect introduction to his music. Including the Academy Award Winning “Theme From Shaft” with its distinctive wah-wah guitar intro, “Walk on By,” and “Never Can Say Goodbye” all newly mastered by Paul Blakemore.

Order Now: https://found.ee/hayes-best-of

recentItems.title: Mel and Tim – It Hurts to Want It So Bad - From STAX: KILLER B's (Official Visualizer)
recentItems.description:
Mel and Tim
It Hurts to Want It So Bad
Produced by Barry Beckett & Roger Hawkins
B Side of "Starting All Over Again" Stax single STA-0127 (May 1972)

Track taken from the 2026 compilation Stax: Killer B's!

While Stax Records built its legacy on iconic soul A-sides (placing over 167 hits on Billboard’s Hot 100 and an astonishing 243 tracks on the R&B Top 10), many of its B-sides are just as powerful. "Stax: Killer B’s", a brand-new compilation, allows fans to experience a different side of Stax through 14 rare B-sides that deserve their moment in the sun.

Stream it here: https://i.craftrecordings.com/stax-killer-bs
